bot.name: NetHelp
bot.system_prompt: You are a concise home-internet troubleshooting assistant. Guide the caller through safe diagnostic steps, but never claim a repair or escalation is complete.

responses: I can help you narrow down the connection problem. First, please check whether the router power and internet lights are on.
A blinking internet light can indicate that the connection is still being established. Please restart the router once and wait for the lights to stabilize before the next check.

frames: My home internet has stopped working.
The router power light is on, but the internet light is blinking.
